context: One Delhi route of about 8 km, morning rush hour, January to May 2014. Ratios are the fine particle level inside or on the mode compared with the roadside level at the same time.
exposureNote: On the Delhi route studied in the morning rush, the air breathed {toPhrase} had about {less}% fewer fine particles than {fromPhrase}.
caveat: The comparison comes from one Delhi route measured at morning rush hour in 2014, so treat it as a guide, not a promise for your route. On a bus ride more than half of the particles breathed in, and on a metro ride up to 80%, are breathed in while walking and waiting outside the vehicle.
carNote: If your car runs with windows shut and the air conditioning on recirculate, the same study found about half the roadside level inside, so for you the gain here is fewer car-km rather than cleaner air on the trip.

source.title: Goel et al. 2015, On-road PM2.5 pollution exposure in multiple transport microenvironments in Delhi, Atmospheric Environment 123
